BillHistory.ReferredCommittee: Referred to Committee on Local Government.

BillHeading.BriefDescription: Concerning technical changes to allowable exemptions for tourism promotion area assessments.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to technical changes to allowable exemptions from charges for tourism promotion area assessments; amending RCW 35.101.055; and creating a new section.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 1. RCW 35.101.055 and 2008 c 137 s 6 are each amended to read as follows:Lodging charge—Exemption for temporary medical housing.
BillSection.P: The lodging charge authorized in RCW 35.101.050 does not apply to temporary medical housing exempt under RCW 82.08.997, or any lodging business, lodging unit, or lodging guest so designated by the legislative authority.

AnnNote.NoteP: Effective date—2008 c 137: See note following RCW 82.08.997.

BillSectionHeader.P: This act applies to any tourism promotion area established before, on, or after the effective date of this section.
